versionContext: Current official docs; retained Convex 1.32.0 semantics. Frozen package version separately recorded in summary. No claim of all-version support.

checks.claim: A binding-resolved Convex database query uses filter without an index or search index.
checks.impact: Without an index restriction, finding matching results may read many table documents. Cost grows with the scanned candidate set, even when few results are returned.
lookalikes: unrelated database-shaped objects, array filters and shadowed bindings
checks.unsupported: Conditional imported registration identity beside a definite registration; unknown check-specific coverage has no public reporting path. Additional custom ownership/config/range limitations remain.
checks.recipeDecision: No maintained recipe models this framework/context/query/patch relationship.
checks.verdict: blocked; production unchanged; positive/lookalike/exact duplicates pass, conditional coverage fails
checks.calibration: Executed filter without index; performance review, not proof of excessive reads. take limits returned results, not candidate reads.

checks.claim: A Convex indexed collect has no returned range restriction established by supported callback flow.
checks.impact: Selecting index order alone does not restrict the candidate set. Actual cardinality and returned-range uncertainty need review.
checks.unsupported: Conditional imported registration identity beside a definite registration; unknown check-specific coverage has no public reporting path. Additional custom ownership/config/range limitations remain.
checks.recipeDecision: No maintained recipe models this framework/context/query/patch relationship.
checks.verdict: blocked; production unchanged; positive/lookalike/exact duplicates pass, conditional coverage fails
checks.calibration: Unrestricted indexed collect can read the whole index; unknown returned callback flow must narrow instead of producing a finding.

checks.claim: A global Date.now() call directly inside an import-resolved Convex query handler.
checks.impact: Time passing does not itself rerun a subscribed query; time-dependent results may become stale and cache reuse can suffer.
checks.unsupported: Conditional imported registration identity beside a definite registration; unknown check-specific coverage has no public reporting path. Additional custom ownership/config/range limitations remain.
checks.recipeDecision: No maintained recipe models this framework/context/query/patch relationship.
checks.verdict: blocked; production unchanged; positive/lookalike/exact duplicates pass, conditional coverage fails
checks.calibration: Direct query Date.now is allowed and fixed per execution; time passing alone does not invalidate subscriptions. Review cache/reactivity while preserving expiry and authorization checks.

checks.claim: A subtraction of two global Date.now() calls, or immutable direct aliases, in the same import-resolved query/mutation handler.
checks.impact: The transaction clock is fixed at function start, so this calculation cannot measure work duration.
checks.unsupported: Conditional imported registration identity beside a definite registration; unknown check-specific coverage has no public reporting path. Additional custom ownership/config/range limitations remain.
checks.recipeDecision: No maintained recipe models this framework/context/query/patch relationship.
checks.verdict: blocked; production unchanged; positive/lookalike/exact duplicates pass, conditional coverage fails
checks.calibration: Subtracting transaction Date.now values cannot measure elapsed execution time. Stored historical timestamps are valid; performance.now differs in mutations and is outside this check.

checks.verdict: blocked; production unchanged; positive/lookalike/exact duplicates pass, conditional coverage fails

checks.claim: A resolved query context invokes a database write, scheduler operation, runMutation or runAction.
checks.impact: Queries are read-only transactions - the write methods do not exist on a query's context, so the function fails on its first real call rather than at deploy time. ctx.runQuery IS allowed (same read snapshot); only mutations, actions, and scheduling are forbidden.
checks.unsupported: Conditional imported registration identity beside a definite registration; unknown check-specific coverage has no public reporting path. Additional custom ownership/config/range limitations remain.
checks.recipeDecision: No maintained recipe models this framework/context/query/patch relationship.
checks.verdict: blocked; production unchanged; positive/lookalike/exact duplicates pass, conditional coverage fails
checks.calibration: Resolved query context is read-only; runQuery is supported. Writes, scheduling, runMutation and runAction are invalid on that context.

checks.claim: A resolved action context invokes a database method, although actions do not provide db.
checks.impact: Actions have no db on their context - the call throws at runtime, usually on the first request that reaches that path.
checks.unsupported: Conditional imported registration identity beside a definite registration; unknown check-specific coverage has no public reporting path. Additional custom ownership/config/range limitations remain.
checks.recipeDecision: No maintained recipe models this framework/context/query/patch relationship.
checks.verdict: blocked; production unchanged; positive/lookalike/exact duplicates pass, conditional coverage fails
checks.calibration: Action context has no direct database reader/writer; use transaction calls. Arbitrary db-shaped objects are outside this claim.

checks.claim: A resolved Convex context runQuery, runMutation or runAction call is directly awaited in a loop body in the same function.
checks.impact: Awaiting each iteration can serialize latency. Transaction and commit behavior depends on run method and calling context; queries can share a read snapshot.
lookalikes: deliberate OCC retry loops with backoff
checks.unsupported: Conditional imported registration identity beside a definite registration; unknown check-specific coverage has no public reporting path. Additional custom ownership/config/range limitations remain.
checks.recipeDecision: No maintained recipe models this framework/context/query/patch relationship.
checks.verdict: blocked; production unchanged; positive/lookalike/exact duplicates pass, conditional coverage fails
checks.calibration: Awaited server calls in loops are review candidates; retries, pagination, ordering and intentional transaction boundaries may require serialization. Local database-write loops are valid.
